description: Registry of the Figma sources of design truth. The Design role syncs published variables/components from these into design/tokens/ via the Figma MCP. Entries may share a fileKey: the parent/child split is logical (pages/sections + token namespaces), not necessarily separate files. focx-bot is a separate product on its own file and shares no values with the focx foundation.

focx-foundation.name: Focx — DS-001 Shell - Today
focx-foundation.scopeHint: Roadmap per the cover: foundations → components → patterns → responsive screens. All content is focx.* scope until Connect pages exist.
focx-foundation.contains: focx design system foundation: variables (color, type, spacing, radius) and components

connect.name: Focx — DS-001 Shell - Today
connect.scopeHint: No Connect-specific pages yet — connect.* deltas begin when Connect surfaces are added to this file (or a dedicated file, at which point only this fileKey changes).
connect.contains: Connect's extension layer: connect-specific variables and components

focx-bot.name: Focx Bot — DS-001 Foundation
focx-bot.scopeHint: Focx Bot's own foundation — a dark DM Sans / Space Grotesk system. It shares no colours or families with the focx foundation, so it does not extend it: every token is an addition under the focx-bot.* namespace. Foundations only; no components or documentation pages yet.
focx-bot.contains: focx-bot foundation: 117 variables across 8 collections, 12 text styles, 4 effect styles
focx-bot.derivedFrom: design/mockup/ — the extraction of focx-bot-desktop.rpt4k.chatgpt.site, captured 2026-09-06

collections.focx-bot/primitives: 37 — neutral ramp, white/black alpha ramps, 6 bot accents, brand orange family, status
collections.focx-bot/color: 27 — semantic, Dark mode, every token aliased to a primitive
collections.focx-bot/type: 25 — 2 families, 6 weights, 10-step size scale, line heights, tracking
collections.focx-bot/space: 12 — ramp collapsing the mockup's 33 one-px-granular values

sync.syncedBy: claude-code (focx-bot foundation authored into Figma from design/mockup/design-values.md, then exported back)

previousSync.syncedBy: claude-code (variables consumed by Cover 9:7 + Button/Primary 28:117 + Button/Destructive 31:117)
